messages:
maria: Quick heads up — I just saw a deprovisioned user retain access to prod-data S3 via a service account. Keys were rotated last week but access is still allowed. permission drift? :eyes:
aj: Which SA and which user? Do we have the SCIM log for the deprov?
maria: user: emma.j, removed 2/18 in SCIM. Affected sa role: sa-analytics-prod. I can repro by assuming the role and listing bucket contents.
sec-bot: Alert: KMS key policy mismatch detected for key alias/ci-prod-logs at 2045129400. Policy grants group principals that no longer exist in SCIM.
ryan: can you paste the key policy? if it's referencing group ARNs that's probably the culprit.
maria: snippet:
```
"Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:group/analytics_prod" }
```
ryan: ugh — we shouldn't be granting to groups in the KMS policy. Our SA roles are role ARNs. That explains why service accounts (with role mapping) still had access: group entry wasn't removed by SCIM deprov.
aj: how did that policy get deployed? terraform? manual?
tara: that key originally created pre-Terraform by infra-legacy. There's a historical terraform import gap. We missed migrating key policies into IaC. :grimacing:
oliver: short term: remove group principal and add the specific role ARNs for the SA(s). long term: reconcile all KMS policies into terraform and add unit that rejects group principals.
devops-runner: quick fix command I used (for audit):
```
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/ci-prod-logs --policy | jq .
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/ci-prod-logs --policy file://fixed-policy.json
```
aj: +1. Add a guardrail so future SCIM deprovs remove group entries or warn on orphaned principals.
ryan: also adding an automated monthly scan that cross-references KMS principals against current IAM roles and SCIM groups. I'll own that.
maria: assign actions:
- tara: migrate key policies to terraform (ETA 48h)
- oliver: apply emergency KMS policy change to remove group principal (done)
- ryan: build monthly KMS principal audit (start tomorrow, target next week)
- aj: update SCIM runbook with deprovision checklist (include KMS review)

oliver: emergency change completed at 2045131200 — removed group principal and added role arn:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sa-analytics-prod. Confirmed emma.j no longer accesses bucket.
maria: verified with assume-role test, :white_check_mark: no access.
tara: starting terraform import for alias/ci-prod-logs now, will open PR when done.
aj: I'll update runbook and add a quick grep that finds KMS policies with "/group/" in them and make it a pre-merge check.
sec-bot: Note: created incident ticket SEC-2026-53 and scheduled postmortem. Bot recorded all log artifacts.
maria: thanks y'all. Let's include lessons in the postmortem: avoid group principals in KMS, import legacy resources, and add cross-service reconciliation between SCIM and KMS.
oliver: also consider a short-lived credential policy for SA roles to limit long lived access even if policy misconfigs happen.
maria: ok closing this thread, will follow up in SEC-2026-53 with the postmortem draft. :lock:
